text: Many people like to volunteer in their free time. To volunteer means to help other people without getting paid. There are many ways to help your community. You can donate old clothes, food, or money to a charity. A charity is an organization that helps people in need. Some charities help homeless people find a warm shelter and food to eat. Other groups help needy families or sick children. If you want to help, you can also fundraise, which means you collect money for a good cause. Volunteering takes effort, but it is a kind thing to do. When people work together, teamwork makes the job easier and more fun. You don't have to give a lot of money to be generous; you can also assist your neighbor by helping them carry bags or clean their garden. Every small contribution helps. Small acts of kindness can help someone feel better. Many people encourage their friends and family to volunteer too, because everyone can benefit from helping others. When you help someone, they often feel thankful, and you feel good too. Volunteering makes communities stronger and kinder places to live.
